verdict.rationale: Perplexity publishes an API reference page for the Sonar endpoint with request/response schemas (docs-23, docs-42) and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probe-3). Separately, it offers an interactive console Playground for running Search queries with no API key (docs-14). The evidence does not show that the reference itself is interactive or has runnable 'try it' examples, and the Playground is documented only for Search. Missing for 10: evidence of in-reference interactive 'try it' request execution, runnable examples across all endpoints (Agent, Embeddings, Orchestrator), independent or hands-on corroboration.
